name: frobenius_norm
description: Exact native contract aten::frobenius_norm.dim(Tensor self, int[] dim, bool keepdim=False) -> Tensor. Reduce over supplied dimensions, retaining them if requested. Output stays on the input device. For the tested real floating inputs, output dtype matches input dtype; complex input behavior is outside the restored test coverage. Preserve duplicate-dimension RuntimeError contract; no mutation or return alias. Restored master tests use candidate-only top-level injection; builtin export is not assumed.
